settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: 32×32 or larger. Leave empty to use the riq mark.

settings.label: WhatsApp number
settings.info: International format, e.g. 9613123456. Powers the enquiry buttons.

settings.label: Enquiry-only mode
settings.info: Hides all prices and replaces Add to cart with a WhatsApp / email enquiry button. Useful while prices are still being set — products priced at 0 always show ‘Price on request’ regardless of this setting.

settings.content: Rating, reviews, address, phone, hours and photos are read live from your Google listing, so they stay current on their own. Two values are needed: the Place ID of the listing, and a Maps Platform API key restricted to this domain. Without them the theme falls back to whatever is typed under Shop details.

settings.label: Place ID
settings.info: Looks like ChIJ… — find it with Google's Place ID Finder.

settings.label: Maps Platform API key
settings.info: Restrict it to HTTP referrers bobmusic.shop/* and to the Places API, or anyone can spend your quota. It is visible in the page source by design; the referrer restriction is what protects it.

settings.label: Google Maps link
settings.info: Used for Directions before the Place ID is set, and as the fallback if the API is unreachable.

settings.label: Rating
settings.info: Shown only until the API answers. e.g. 4.8
